notes.title: Patch 0.10.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Small patch fixing bugs

[list]
[*] Fixes issue in the salon mission where the first mini boss wasn't spawning locking progression
[*] Fixes an issue with some bad ends unlocked screens not functioning correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.10.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Small Patch fixing bugs and typos

[list]
[*] Several error causing bugs fixed, notable no more error when closing the bad end menu
[*] Error in unlocking the Zookeeper achievement fixed, to get this replay the mission either from the chapter list or the mission list
[*] Several typos fixed throughout the game
[*] Updated Salon mission mechanics with the tanning beds, now visually clear which one holds the bimbo and opening incorrect ones will cause will power damage
[/list]
